ev.q: Metroidvania-style side-scrolling exploration with monster-taming and turn-based combat
Defeating monsters yields eggs that can be hatched and added to the player's roster
Weapons, armor and skill trees let players build specialised monster teams
a pixel art world full of wild creatures
The combat system drew wide praise for its strategic depth
Players can also battle each other online in a player-versus-player mode
battles could feel slow at times
